result.title: FlyingDrones: A Dataset and Benchmark for Optical Flow Estimation from UAV motion
result.summary: Optical flow is an important cue for drone analysis in aerial surveillance, airspace monitoring, and long-range target tracking, where motion remains informative when appearance is weak. Estimating the motion of small Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, however, is difficult because distant targets occupy few pixels, have low contrast, and move against complex dynamic backgrounds. Standard optical-flow benchmarks emphasize large, object-centric motions and therefore do not characterize distant aerial targets well. We introduce FlyingDrones, a generated benchmark with dense ground-truth optical flow and segmentation masks derived from physically based rendering, and define resolution-normalized metrics (EPE Norm) that normalize flow by image dimensions. We evaluate 16 state-of-the-art model families on a motion- and size-stratified subset of 999 flow pairs at three resolutions. Every family recovers drone motion better than the zero-flow reference, but the gap between families widens with resolution: at 1920x1080, global-matching, recurrent, transformer, and short-window temporal models separate clearly from pyramid, classical, self-supervised, lightweight, and diffusion models. Within-family checkpoint spread is comparable to or larger than between-family spread, so the training curriculum is as important as the architecture. Two complementary studies test the benchmark beyond synthetic accuracy: a ground-truth-free motion-alignment evaluation on 21 cameras of real UAV footage shows that the synthetic ranking carries a moderate, significant signal about real-world performance (Spearman \r{ho} = 0.63 over 41 checkpoints) while the exact top ranks differ, and a fine-tuning study shows that 800 FlyingDrones pairs reduce held-out drone-region error by up to 37% and improve drone localization on the real footage for all four architectures tested.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 FlyingDrones，一个基于物理渲染生成、带稠密光流真值与分割掩码的无人机运动估计基准，定义按图像尺寸归一化的 EPE 指标，并在三种分辨率下比较 16 类光流模型，另做合成到真实画面的排序相关性分析与小样本微调实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文不涉及 VLM 或 latent 推理状态；但「外观信息弱时由运动提供线索」及小目标在低分辨率下像素极少的问题，可能与动态背景中视觉证据筛选、分辨率对内部状态信息保留的影响存在概念联系，可供核查。
